A.text: This document observes the kernel's declarations at pins, the bench's banked numbers, the field at its pins: the record of what was done and measured. It writes to the observational layer, append-only, dated. Its readers are the editions and the monograph, which cite it and do not restate it. It is not a claim: RH reduced to a single located clause, reduction machine-verified; not RH proved. It is written without narrative. It is not a tracking document: The cascade is the audit. The work-orders it has generated are the research; the editions wait for the work-orders.

B.text: Its object: the kernel's declarations at pins, the bench's banked numbers, the field at its pins. Its layer, the observational: relay banks, the four ledgers, the terminal table, the censuses — append-only, dated, the record of what was done and measured. Its readers: the editions and the monograph, which cite it and do not restate it, written from the observational layer at checkpoints. It is not a claim: neither is proved; it is written without narrative; it is not a tracking document: an audit of a conclusion's standing is not its documentation.
